raw_html: [[Nightmares#Sovereign Nightmares|Sovereign Nightmares]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Nightmares#Sovereign Nightmares|Sovereign Nightmares]]:''' On [[Vorpal Strike|Vorpal Hit]] with any weapon: If your target has below 5,000 Hit Points, a burst of pure terror emanates from this weapon, snuffing out its life as if it were the subject of a [[Phantasmal Killer]] spell. If your target has above 5,000 Hit Points, they instead take significant Force damage.
